strings.name: Lee Hsien Loong
strings.summary: Lee Hsien Loong studied mathematics and computing at Cambridge and public administration at Harvard. After an army career, he entered politics in 1984. Prime minister from 2004 to 2024, he pursued finance, social protection and Smart Nation policies amid major-power rivalry and the pandemic. He became senior minister after stepping down, within a political system long dominated by the PAP.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Long served as Singapore’s prime minister, advancing financial, urban and technology policies and playing a role in Southeast Asia and major-power relations.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Mathematics and computing, Cambridge; Master in Public Administration, Harvard (1980).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Twenty years as premier
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led government from 2004 to 2024 through financial crisis and pandemic.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Smart Nation
strings.highlights.h2.text: Launched the 2014 initiative to digitise public services.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Became senior minister
strings.timeline.t1.text: Handed the premiership to Lawrence Wong and remained in cabinet.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Smart Nation launched
strings.timeline.t2.text: Proposed digital technology for public services and urban life.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Became prime minister
strings.timeline.t3.text: Succeeded Goh Chok Tong as Singapore’s third premier.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Finance minister
strings.timeline.t4.text: Held the finance portfolio alongside the deputy premiership until 2007.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Deputy prime minister
strings.timeline.t5.text: Joined senior government leadership on economic and public policy.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Entered parliament
strings.timeline.t6.text: Elected after leaving the army, beginning his political career.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Completed Cambridge studies
strings.timeline.t7.text: Earned a mathematics degree and computer science diploma.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Singapore
strings.timeline.t8.text: His father Lee Kuan Yew later became the first prime minister.
